title: Hellebuyck makes 43 saves, improves to 7-0 with Devils in win over Capitals
text:
Hellebuyck makes 43 saves, improves to 7-0 with Devils in win over Capitals - Sportsnet.ca 
 Loading... Hellebuyck makes 43 saves, improves to 7-0 with Devils in win over Capitals
 Associated Press November 14, 2026 - 10:59pm New Jersey Devils goaltender Connor Hellebuyck (37) stops the puck during the third period of an NHL hockey game against the Washington Capitals, Saturday, Nov. 14, 2026, in Washington. (AP Photo/Nick Wass) 
 WASHINGTON — Connor Hellebuyck recovered from a shaky start to make 43 saves, remaining unbeaten in net with New Jersey as the surging Devils defeated the Washington Capitals 7-4 on Saturday night.
 Evan Rodrigues scored twice for the Devils, who earned their second win against Washington in three days. Jesper Boqvist, Connor Brown and Lenni Hameenaho each had a goal and an assist.
 Nico Hischier and Timo Meier also scored to help New Jersey improve to 11-2 since Oct. 20 with its seventh victory in eight games. Meier's power-play goal late in the second period gave the Devils their first lead, 4-3, and Hischier's short-handed goal made it 5-3 early in the third.
 Rodrigues scored at 3:18 to make it 6-4 and added an empty-netter with 3:15 left.
 Hellebuyck gave up three goals in the first but only one after that. He's won all seven starts with the Devils after being traded by the Winnipeg Jets on Oct. 23.
